[1] Richter co-starred as Ron Weasley in the fan-parody musicals, "A Very Potter Musical" (2009), "A Very Potter Sequel" (2010) and "A Very Potter Senior Year" (2012) with Bonnie Gruesen and Glee star Darren Criss, created by University of Michigan theatre group, StarKid Productions.

[3] She has made fashion accessories and recorded an audiobook of "Foster" by Claire Keegan.
